cart.lead: Products, pricing, promotions, and inventory are checked again before checkout. Cached amounts never create an order.
cart.title: Review product configurations

orders.lead: Payment, review, provisioning, and cancellation always follow the latest server facts.
orders.title: My orders

order.contractOptional: Ordinary individual orders do not require a contract. Only orders explicitly marked by staff follow contract gating.
order.label: Order

quote.changed: The price changed. Review the new amount before placing the order.
quote.title: Checkout quote

configuration.required: Complete the purchase configuration for every product before placing the order.

payment.identityDescription: Identity verification is required before the first payment. Return here to continue the same order without creating another one.
payment.ready: Identity and order checks passed. You can continue to payment methods.
payment.readyDescription: The order is never shown as paid before funds are received.

cancel.description: Payment, funds, and resources are checked again. Unsafe closure moves to manual handling and never releases resources prematurely.
cancel.title: Cancel this order?

messages.actionFailed: The action did not finish. Retry from the latest page state.
messages.cancelled: The cancellation request was accepted and the page was refreshed.
messages.checkoutFailed: The order was not submitted. Keep this page open and try again.
messages.loadFailed: This page is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
messages.mergeFailed: The website cart was not merged. Keep your browser data and try again shortly.
messages.quoteFailed: Pricing did not finish. The cart has been reloaded.
